digest.component_or_area: rebar graph link store and reconciler
propositions: Write path for links is relation-scoped via (target_id, relation) key in add_dependency, allowing one pair to hold multiple differently-related deps (e.g., blocks and relates_to simultaneously), but removal path is pair-scoped with no relation parameter, causing asymmetry

When inbound removal records reach G5 guard due to vendor-type deduping in outbound differ, pair-scoped unlink declines permanently if the pair's most-recent net-active relation does not match the vanished relation, causing non-convergent re-emission and re-decline on every pass

Relation-scoped removal seam added at graph layer (remove_dependency symmetric with add_dependency), keyed on (target_id, relation) with optional relation filter in _get_link_info replay, enabling reconciler's _inbound_unlink_one to converge by removing exactly the mirrored relation

CLI rebar unlink gains optional relation argument; with no relation argument existing pair-scoped most-recent behavior is byte-for-byte unchanged (backward compatible); library facade rebar.unlink gains optional relation=None keyword

Safety invariant preserved: relation-scoped removal removes only the named relation; when named relation has no matching net-active local link, removal is a logged no-op and no other relation's link is ever removed
